definitions.explanation: A line that bends smoothly without angles.

examples.japanese: {曲線|きょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{曲線|きょくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
{曲線|きょくせん}⟦{美|び}→美：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かした→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a design that makes use of curved beauty.

notes:
{曲線|きょくせん} refers to a line that bends smoothly without sharp angles. It is used in mathematics, art, design, and everyday descriptions of roads or shapes. The kanji combine ⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (to bend) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：noentry⟧ (line).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {曲線|きょくせん}: curved line
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧: straight line
- ⟦{折|お}れ{線|せん}→折れ線：23011_oresen⟧: zigzag line, broken line (with angles)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {曲線|きょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw/trace a curve
- {曲線|きょくせん}⟦{美|び}→美：noentry⟧: beauty of curves (often in art or architecture)
- {曲線|きょくせん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: line graph with curves
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧{曲線|きょくせん}: growth curve

USAGE DOMAINS:
- Mathematics: ⟦{放物|ほうぶつ}{線|せん}→放物線：20966_houbutsusen⟧ (parabola), {曲線|きょくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方程式|ほうていしき}→方程式：04795_houteishiki⟧ (equation of a curve)
- Design/art: {曲線|きょくせん}⟦{美|び}→美：noentry⟧, {曲線|きょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧ (make use of curves)
- Roads: {曲線|きょくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧ (road with many curves)
